newsitem.title: USA: CATHERINES JULY SAME STORE SALES RISE.
newsitem.headline: CATHERINES JULY SAME STORE SALES RISE.

text.p: Catherines Stores Corp reported Thursday that total sales for the four-week period ended Aug. 2, 1997, rose 5.3 percent to $20.0 million from the year ago's $19.0 million. Comparable store sales rose 4.1 percent.
Total sales for the second quarter rose to $70.7 million from $68.8 million and year-to-date total sales increased to $141.6 million from $139.3 million in 1996.
Same-store sales rose 1.5 percent for the second quarter and slipped 0.2 percent year to date.

During the month of July, five unprofitable stores were closed. The company plans to open its final new store for the year in August. The company also anticipates closing three unprofitable stores in August.
Catherines Stores Corp is a Memphis-based specialty retailer selling large-size women's apparel in 455 stores in 40 states.
